BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COU>JCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

hereby amended by changing all of the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House)
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 3-K in the area bouncJed by:

13.   Describe the proposed use of the property after the rezoning. Indicate the number of dwelling
